cues: Opens with a "Scope and assumptions" section that disambiguates (A) vs (B) and lists requirements, which suggests a structured planning step
Ends with "Decisions to make early" and a list of clarifying questions, which could come from a methodology
Includes phased delivery, failure-mode table, invariants and testing strategy. These are thorough but typical of a strong unguided answer
No explicit methodology artifacts such as numbered steps, risk registers, open-questions headers, verification checklists or stated alternatives considered. It reads as a free-form expert design doc
Only one "why not X" trade-off (database-per-tenant), with the rest asserted directly, so it is less like a prescribed template
